name: IOL Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd
about: IOL Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd is a leading pharmaceutical (APIs) company and is a significant player in the specialty chemicals space. It serves the domestic and export market.[1]It is the largest player of Ibuprofen (pain killer) globally with a world market share of 35%.[2]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 20.6%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 1.88% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 8.09% over last 3 years.
